result.title: Property-Based Testing for Robust Softmax and Cross-Entropy
result.summary: A recent paper of Barron et. al. (2026) identified two numerical issues with the softmax and cross-entropy functions in virtually all standard machine learning libraries (e.g., PyTorch and JAX). We show that these issues can be recovered through simple property-based tests in Hypothesis. However, our tests identify an additional edge case where their implementation fails. We then propose an even more robust softmax implementation which passes these tests and also supports use in causal attention masking. We compare our implementation with theirs and discuss some of the differences. Overall, this work shows that property-based testing can be a powerful tool for discovering and fixing numerical issues in machine learning libraries. Our implementations and property-based tests can be found at https://github.com/mmaaz-git/softmax-fix.

AI.brief_summary: 该文用 Hypothesis 的基于属性测试复现 softmax 与交叉熵的数值问题，发现新的边界情形，并提出更稳健且支持因果注意力掩码的实现。
